learner.en: kid riding with a grown-up and talking to the driver
learner.es: niño o niña que viaja con un adulto y habla con el chofer

goal.en: Ask if this bus goes to the library, ask how much it costs, and thank the driver when you get off.
goal.es: Preguntar si este autobús va a la biblioteca, preguntar cuánto cuesta y darle las gracias al chofer al bajar.

must_use.en: Does this bus go to the library?

success.en: You get to the library, and the driver smiles because you said thank you.
success.es: Llegas a la biblioteca, y el chofer sonríe porque diste las gracias.

show_staff_line.en: I'm practicing my English. Thank you for your patience.
show_staff_line.es: Estoy practicando mi español. Gracias por su paciencia.

partner.en: Hop on! Where are you headed?

text.en: Does this bus go to the library?

tip.en: Ask the whole question: "Does this bus go to the library?"
tip.es: Haz la pregunta completa: "Does this bus go to the library?"

text.en: Does this train go to the library?

tip.en: This is a bus! Say "Does this bus go to the library?"
tip.es: ¡Es un autobús! Di "Does this bus go to the library?"

tip.en: In a question, "is" goes before "it": "How much is it?"
tip.es: En una pregunta, «is» va antes de «it»: "How much is it?"

tip.en: Everyone pays on the bus. Ask "How much is it?"
tip.es: En el autobús todos pagan. Pregunta "How much is it?"

partner.en: Kids ride free with a grown-up. Have a seat!
partner.es: Los niños viajan gratis con un adulto. ¡Siéntate!

text.en: Okay. Can you tell me when to get off?

tip.en: The driver asked you to sit. Say "Okay! Thank you."
tip.es: El chofer te pidió sentarte. Di "Okay! Thank you."

partner.en: This is your stop. The library is right there.
partner.es: Esta es tu parada. La biblioteca está justo ahí.

tip.en: Say thank you first: "Thank you, driver!"
tip.es: Primero da las gracias: "Thank you, driver!"

tip.en: The driver just told you: right there. Say "Thank you, driver!"
tip.es: El chofer te acaba de decir: justo ahí. Di "Thank you, driver!"
